tips.startTitle: Fara da minti {{minutes}} kawai a rana
tips.startBody: A shekaru {{age}}, ko minti {{minutes}} na atisayen karatu a kowace rana yana kawo babban bambanci. Ku gwada karatu tare a lokaci ɗaya kowace rana — kafin barci ko bayan makaranta yana da kyau. Dagewa ya fi tsawon lokaci muhimmanci.
tips.dailyTitle: Ku yi ƙoƙarin karatu kowace rana — burin minti {{minutes}}
tips.dailyBody: Kun riga kun saba da karatu akai-akai, wannan abin a yaba ne. Mayar da shi al'adar yau da kullum — ko da minti {{minutes}} ne — zai ƙara saurin ci gaban ɗanku sosai. Kaɗan-kaɗan akai-akai shi ne sirrin.
tips.brilliantTitle: Kuna yin aiki mai kyau ƙwarai
tips.brilliantBody: Karatu kowace rana a shekaru {{age}} yana ɗaya daga cikin abubuwa mafi kyau da za ku iya yi. Ku ci gaba — minti {{minutes}} a rana ya isa sosai. Ɗanku yana gina ginshiƙai masu ƙarfi na karatu.
tips.bilingualBody: Yin magana da harsuna biyu a gida babban amfani ne ga ci gaban ƙwaƙwalwar ɗanku. Ku ci gaba da magana da harsunan biyu — ba ya rage saurin karatun Turanci. Ku karanta littattafan fonikis da Turanci, amma littattafan labari da kowane ɗaya daga cikin harsunan.
tips.moreEnglishTitle: Ƙarin lokacin karatun Turanci zai taimaka
tips.moreEnglishBody: Tunda Turanci ba shi ne babban harshen gida ba, ɗanku zai iya buƙatar ɗan ƙarin atisayen fonikis kowace rana don samun ƙwarewa. Ku yi ƙoƙarin samar da minti 10–15 na karatun Turanci tare da harshen gidanku — dukansu suna da amfani.
tips.dyslexiaTitle: Karatu ta hanyoyin ji da yawa ya fi dacewa
tips.dyslexiaBody: Ga yara masu matsalar karatu (dyslexia), fonikis yana da muhimmanci musamman — haka ma haƙuri. Ku yi amfani da maɓallan sauti, ku bi siffar haruffa da yatsu, kuma ku riƙa gajarta zama (minti 5–10). Ku yi murnar kowace ƙaramar nasara. Ci gaba zai iya yin jinkiri amma na gaske ne.
tips.speechBody: Yara masu buƙatun magana da harshe suna amfana sosai daga jin sautuka a sarari. Ku riƙa amfani da maɓallan sauti akai-akai, kuma ku ba ɗanku ƙarin lokaci don amsawa. Idan zai iya jin sautin, zai iya koyon karanta shi — ko da furta shi ya fi wuya.
tips.ealTitle: Fonikis yana aiki sosai ga masu koyon Turanci a matsayin ƙarin harshe
tips.ealBody: Fonikis mai tsari yana ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyi mafi tasiri ga yaran da ke koyon Turanci a matsayin ƙarin harshe. Sautukan suna daidai kuma ana iya hasashensu. Ku haɗa atisayen fonikis da littattafan hotuna don gina kalmomi tare da koyon karanta su.
tips.adhdBody: Ku riƙe zaman karatu a minti 5–8 — gajerun zama da cikakken hankali sun fi dogayen zama masu raba hankali. Ku gwada ƙara motsi: tashi tsaye tsakanin shafuka, yi amfani da abin nuni don bin kalmomi, ko yi tsallen tauraro bayan kowane shafi. Ku sa ya zama mai motsi!
tips.gapTitle: Rufe giɓin abu ne mai yiwuwa sosai
tips.gapBody: Ɗanku ya ɗan baya a kan tsammanin Birtaniya na shekarunsa — amma wannan abu ne na al'ada kuma ana iya gyara shi cikin sauƙi. Da minti {{minutes}} na atisayen fonikis kowace rana a Mataki na {{level}}, yawancin yara suna kamo sauran cikin zangon karatu ɗaya. Mabuɗin shi ne atisaye akai-akai, ba haddace cikin gaggawa ba.
tips.homeschoolBody: A matsayinku na iyalin da ke karatu a gida, kuna da damar kulawa ɗaya-da-ɗaya. Ku bi matakan bisa tsari — kowane littafi yana gina kan wanda ya gabace shi. Gajeren zaman fonikis kowace rana (minti 10–15) sannan karatu na sakin jiki yana aiki sosai.
tips.schoolSupportTitle: Fonikis a gida yana tallafa wa karatun makaranta
tips.schoolSupportBody: Makarantar ɗanku na iya amfani da wata hanyar koyar da karatu daban. MyPhonicsBooks yana bin tsarin karatun fonikis na Birtaniya, wanda ke da tsari kuma an tabbatar da shi da hujjoji. Ko minti 10 a gida zai ƙarfafa abin da yake koya a makaranta.
tips.headStartTitle: Kuna ba shi damar fara gaba
tips.headStartBody: Fara fonikis kafin makaranta kyauta ce mai ban mamaki. Ku sa ya zama wasa — babu matsi, sai nishaɗi da sautuka. Ɗanku zai isa makaranta yana da ƙwarin gwiwa da haruffa da sautuka, wanda ke kawo bambanci na gaske.

reveal.title: Littafinku na kyauta ya shirya
reveal.body: Bisa sakamakonku, kun buɗe wannan littafin kyauta.
